mistakes.title: Missing decoupling capacitor
mistakes.explanation: U1 has a power pin on net 'VCC', but no bypass/decoupling capacitor connects that net to a recognized ground return. Without local decoupling, supply transients from switching current can couple into the IC and cause glitches, resets, or radiated noise.
mistakes.fix_suggestion: Add a decoupling capacitor (typically 100nF, or per the datasheet) from VCC to the nearest ground return, placed within a few mm of U1's power pin.

mistakes.title: LED missing series resistor
mistakes.explanation: D1 has no confirmed series resistor in its net topology. Driving an LED without a series current-limiting resistor risks over-current damage or a shortened lifespan, since the LED's own forward resistance is not a reliable current limit.
mistakes.fix_suggestion: Add a series resistor in-line with D1, sized for the LED's rated forward current at the supply voltage in use (unless current limiting is already provided by a dedicated driver IC).
